coordinateConvention: ICCS: a0 is Red's left corner; files a-i, ranks 0-9; uppercase pieces are Red; N=horse, B=elephant.
execution: Load startFen; replay prefix, then cycle exactly cyclesToPlay times. Keep physical piece identities across all plies. Expected result is from the official family ruling, after sufficient repetition.
verificationScope: All coordinate lines pass an independent piece-movement, obstruction, palace, river, horse-leg, elephant-eye, self-check, and facing-kings replay check. This is reference-fixture preparation, not evidence that any target adjudicator passes.
officialSource: 2018 World Xiangqi Rules, numbered diagrams 1-110, printed pages 40-99 (PDF pages 48-107).
